message: Then show me what raising the beams to 3 MW would do. Propose it — don't apply it.

history.content: Which edits can the archive actually test on shot 30166?
On 30166 the matched pairs can test density, beam power and beam timing; current and field edits are refused — too few matched pairs to test any response law.

deltas: Proposed, not applied: at 3.0 MW (1.40 × the shot's 2.14813 MW logged peak) flat-top stored energy changes +6.5% to +14.2% across the response laws, compared with MAST data. Nothing is applied yet — confirming in the what-if panel is yours to do. An educational comparison, never a prediction.
